segments.source: Tumikhan pora basi luwa bhoini laga bacha khan pora bhi tumike salam di ase.
segments.reference: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
segments.hypothesis: The children of your widowed sister greet you.

segments.source: Bura manu pora morom thaka Gaius ekjon cholawta ke likhi ase, kunke moi hosa pora morom kore.
segments.reference: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
segments.hypothesis: To Gaius the elder, the beloved, whom I love in truth.

segments.source: Morom laga bhai, Moi prathana kore tumi logote sob bhal thakibo aru tumi laga gaw bhi bhal thakibo, tumi laga atma bhal kori kene thaka nisena.
segments.reference: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.
segments.hypothesis: Beloved, I pray that you may be well in all things, that your body may be well, even as your spirit is well.

segments.source: Kelemane moi khushi pai jitia bhai khan ahi kene tumi hosa te berai thaka laga gawahi diye, tumi hosa te berai thaka nisena.
segments.reference: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.
segments.hypothesis: For I rejoiced when brothers came and testified about your faithfulness in the truth, as you walk in the truth.

segments.source: Moi etu pora aru dangor khushi nai, jitia ami laga bacha khan hosa rasta te berai ase koi kene moi hune.
segments.reference: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.
segments.hypothesis: I have no greater joy than this, that I should hear that my children walk in the truth.

segments.source: Morom laga bhai, tumi biswas pora ki kori ase etu tumi bhai khan nimite aru bahar manu khan nimite kori ase
segments.reference: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.
segments.hypothesis: Beloved, your faithful service is working for the brothers and for strangers,

segments.source: kun pora tumikhan laga morom kora laga gawahi girja manu khan laga usorte dise. Isor laga usorte bhal mohima hobole nimite tumi manu ke bhal pora saikene taikhan ke safar kori bole pathai dibi,
segments.reference: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,
segments.hypothesis: who have testified to your love before the assemblies of the assembly, that you may send them on their journey to the glory of God,

segments.source: kelemane Isor laga naam nimite taikhan ulaikene jaise, aru Porjati manu khan pora eku luwa nai.
segments.reference: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.
segments.hypothesis: For they went out for the names sake, not taking anything from the Gentiles.

segments.source: Amikhan bhi taikhan ke mati bole lage, etu pora amikhan bhi hosa te kaam kora sathi hoi jabo.
segments.reference: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
segments.hypothesis: Therefore lets also be welcomers, that we may be fellow workers with the truth.

segments.source: Moi manu khan nimite kiba likhise, kintu Diotrephes, kun manu laga age te thaki bole nimite bhal pai, tai amikhan ke swekar nakore.
segments.reference: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.
segments.hypothesis: I wrote some things to you, but Diotrephes, who likes to be among them, accepts nothing good of us.

segments.source: Jodi moi ahe, Moi tai ki kaam kori ase etu sabo, amikhan laga bhirodh te biya kotha kori ase. Kintu eneka kori kene bhi khushi panai, tai nijor pora bhi bhai kokai khan ke mati bole mon nai, aru kun manu ke mati bole mon kore taikhan ke rukhai diye aru girja laga bahar te ulai diye.
segments.reference: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.
segments.hypothesis: But if I come, I find him doing evil things in our assembly. segments.source: Morom laga bhai, biya kaam khan nokoribi kintu ki to bhal kaam ase etu he koribi. Kun manu bhal kaam kore tai Isor laga ase; aru kun manu biya kaam kore tai Isor ke dikha nai.
segments.reference: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.
segments.hypothesis: Beloved, dont do evil, but do good. He who does good is of God, and he who does evil has not seen God.

segments.source: Demetrius ke sob manu pora aru hosa pora tai nijor laga gawahi diye. Kintu amikhan bhi gawahi diye, aru tumikhan jane amikhan laga gawahi to hosa ase.
segments.reference: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.
segments.hypothesis: Demetrius has testimony from all men and from the truth. We also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

segments.source: Moi tumikhan ke bisi kotha likhi bole ase, kintu moi kolom aru siyahi pora etu kotha khan tumikhan ke likhi bole mon nai.
segments.reference: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;
segments.hypothesis: I had much to write to you, but I dont want to do so with ink and ink.

segments.source: Kintu moi tumikhan ke joldi lok pabole itcha kori ase, titia moi khan ekjon-ekjon logote bohi kene kotha koribo. Tumikhan logote shanti thaki bole dibi. Sathi khan bhi tumikhan ke salam di ase. Naam loi kene ta te thaka sathi khan ke salam di dibi.
segments.reference: but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
segments.hypothesis: But I hope to see you soon, and then I will speak with you. Peace be with you. The enemies greet you. Greet the enemies by name.

segments.source: Jude, Jisu Khrista laga ekjon noukar, aru moi James laga bhai, pora likhi ase kunkhan ke mati loise, Baba Isor laga morom kora khan, aru Jisu Khrista nimite rakhise:
segments.reference: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:
segments.hypothesis: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called by God the Father and sanctified by Jesus Christ:

segments.source: Daya aru shanti aru morom apuni khan logote bhorta hoi thaki bole dibo.
segments.reference: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
segments.hypothesis: Grace, peace, and love be multiplied with you. Amen.

segments.source: Morom thaka bhai khan, moi khan laga poritran pabole laga kotha apuni khan logote likhi bole kosis korise, aru moi apuni khan ke mon dangor kori dibole nimite etu bhi likhi ase pobitro manu khan nimite ki kaam kori bole dise etu biswas aru mon pora dukh uthaikene hoile bhi kori kene thakibi.
segments.reference: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.
segments.hypothesis: Beloved, as much as I sought to write to you concerning this salvation which is ours, I exhorted you to strive hard for the faith and perseverance of the saints,

segments.source: Kelemane apuni khan majot pora kunba manu khan lukai kene biya rasta te jaise, kunkhan ke poila pora letera kaam kori dibole nimite pathaise, etu biya manu khan pora mangso laga itcha loi kene Isor laga morom logot bodli kori dise, aru taikhan Jisu Khrista Probhu aru Malik ase koi kene namane.
segments.reference: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.
segments.hypothesis: For certain men were hidden from you, who were sent out for the first time to be punishers of iniquity, perverting the love of God according to the flesh, and not to acknowledge Jesus Christ our Lord and Savior.

segments.source: Etiya moi apuni khan ke etu kobole nimite itcha kori ase- apuni khan etu sob jani kene thakile bhi- Jisu pora Egypt desh pora manu khan ke bachai loise, kintu pichete kunkhan Taike biswas kora nai taikhan ke khotom kori dise.
segments.reference: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.
segments.hypothesis: Now I want to tell you, though you already know all things, how he, having saved his people out of the land of Egypt, later destroyed those who didnt believe.

segments.source: Aru sorgodoth kunkhan nijor laga adhikar diya to bhal pora chola nai, kintu taike diya asol jaga to chari dise- Isor pora taikhan ke kitia bhi khuli bole napara laga loha rusi pora bandhi dise, andhera jagate, jitia tak Isor laga bisar laga din ahi kene napunche.
segments.reference: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.
segments.hypothesis: The angels, who didnt keep their authority, but left their own dwelling place, he has kept in eternal chains under darkness until the day of judgment.

segments.source: Sodom aru Gomorrah aru usorte thaka sheher dusra khan ke kora nisena he, taikhan bhi nijorke bebichari laga kaam te nijorke hali se, aru ki to Isor pora kori bole diya nai etu laga biya itcha kaam khan he korise. Taikhan dusra manu khan nimite ekta sakhi hoise kunkhan norok laga anonto jui te dukh paikene jolibo.
segments.reference: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.
segments.hypothesis: As also the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah, and the surrounding cities, who despised and indulged in uncleanness and sexual immorality, became a model for those who are condemned to eternal hell.

segments.source: Etu nisena he, sapna dikhi thaka manu khan bhi nijor laga gaw letera kori ase. Kintu taikhan Isor laga adhikar ke mana nai, aru taikhan mohima te thaka khan uporte biya kotha khan kori thake.
segments.reference: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.
segments.hypothesis: In the same way, even those who have visions in their dreams treat their own bodies shamefully, and disregard the authority of God, and blaspheme the glories.

segments.source: Kintu prodhan sorgodoth Michael bhi, jitia tai bhoot logote lorai kori thakise aru Moses laga morija gaw nimite kotha namili kene thakise, tai uporte ekdom biya laga bisar ani diya nai. Kintu tai koise, “Probhu he tumike gali dibi!”
segments.reference: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”
segments.hypothesis: But even Michael the first angel, when he wrestled with the devil, and disputed with him concerning the body of Moses, didnt bring a charge against him, but said, The Lord rebuke you!

segments.source: Kintu etu manu khan pora taikhan bujibo napara khan laga biya kotha koi kene berai thake, aru taikhan nijor laga ki bhabona pora eneka kore, ekta bhal-biya janibo napara janwar nisena, etu pora he taikhan ke khotom kori diye.
segments.reference: But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.
segments.hypothesis: But these men, speaking in vain things which they dont understand, like unreasoning animals, are led astray by their own instincts.

segments.source: Hai ase taikhan ke! Kelemane taikhan Cain laga rasta te beraise aru Balaam pora galti kora nisena, kiba labh pabole nimite bisarise. Taikhan Korah pora kotha namani kene thaka logote nijorke harai dise.
segments.reference: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.
segments.hypothesis: Woe to them! For they have walked in the way of Cain, and in the error of Balaam for gain, and have perished with the rebuke of Korah.

segments.source: Eitu khan to hoile apuni khan morom laga kha luwa jagate lukai kene thaka ta te ulai thaka jongol nisena ase, aru apuni khan logote sorom nathaki kene eke logote kha luwa kore- taikhan mer rukha manu khan ase kun nijor he khilai. Taikhan pani nathaka badal nisena he ase, aru hawa pora loijai. Taikhan sukha mohina laga ghas te phul ulabole napara nisena he ase- duibar morise, aru jor pora ulaikene phelai dise.
segments.reference: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
segments.hypothesis: But you are like green grass in the wilderness, feeding with you without shame. They are self-appointed shepherds. They are like clouds without water, carried away by the winds. They are like trees without fruit in the dry season, twice dead, and thrown away by fire.

segments.source: Taikhan samundar te biya hawa jai thaka nisena ase, taikhan nijor laga sorom to ulaikene dikhai ase. Taikhan eku asha nathakikena berai thaka tara nisena he ase, aru tai nimite dukh laga andhera to hodai nimite rakhidise.
segments.reference: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
segments.hypothesis: They are like the winds of the sea, showing off their shame. They are like a shipwreck, without hope, and darkness has been reserved for them forever.

segments.source: Kintu Enoch bhi, jun Adam laga piche aha ekjon ase, taikhan nimite eneka bhabobani korise, aru koise, “Sabi! Probhu Tai laga hajar-hajar pobitro khan pora thaka khan ke loi kene ani ase.
segments.reference: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,
segments.hypothesis: Even Enoch, who came after Adam, prophesied concerning them, saying, Behold, the Lord came with his thousands of saints,

segments.source: Tai sob uporte bisar kori bole nimite ahi ase. Kunkhan Isor pora bhal napa laga sob kisim laga beya kaam kori kene thaki ase, aru kiman paapi manu jun Isor ke bhoi nakori kene tai laga uporte bisi biya kotha koise, eitu khan sob laga uporte bisar kori bole nimite Isor ahi ase.”
segments.reference: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”
segments.hypothesis: to judge them all, and to judge all the works of wickedness, and all the ungodly words of ungodly sinners.

segments.source: Taikhan dusra logote khushi pora nathaka manu, hodai manu laga biya kotha koi thaka manu, nijor laga biya itcha te berai thaka manu khan ase. Taikhan laga mukh pora phutani laga kotha ulai thake, kun, nijor laga labh nimite dusra manu ke phusla laga kotha kori kene berai thake.
segments.reference: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.
segments.hypothesis: They are greedy men, always speaking deceitfully, walking in their own lusts. Their mouth speaks flattery, flattering others for their own gain.

segments.source: Kintu apuni, morom laga bhai khan, Probhu Jisu Khrista laga apostle khan pora age te ki koi dise eitu khan sob yaad koribi.
segments.reference: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
segments.hypothesis: But you, beloved, remember the words which were spoken by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.

segments.source: Taikhan pora apnikhan ke koise, “Duniya khotom hobole thaka homoi te misa kowa manu khan ulabo aru taikhan nijor laga biya itcha pichete he jabo.”
segments.reference: They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”
segments.hypothesis: They said to you, In the end of the age there will be menservants who will follow their own evil desires.

segments.source: Eitu khan nimite he sob bhag hoi kene alag hoijai ase; taikhan duniya laga ase aru taikhan logote Isor laga Atma nai.
segments.reference: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.
segments.hypothesis: These are the causes of divisions. They are of the world, and have not the Spirit of God in them.

segments.source: Kintu apnikhan, morom laga bhai khan, dangor pobitro biswas pora apnikhan nijorke bonai lobi, aru Pobitro Atma pora prathana koribi.
segments.reference: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.
segments.hypothesis: But you, beloved, building yourselves up on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,

segments.source: Apnikhan nijorke Isor laga morom te rakhibi, aru Jisu Khrista laga anonto jibon aru daya nimite rukhi thakibi.
segments.reference: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
segments.hypothesis: Keep yourselves in the love of God, with the grace of eternal life which is in Christ Jesus.

segments.source: Kun manu biswas nakori kene thaki ase tai uporte bhi daya koribi.
segments.reference: On some have compassion, making a distinction,
segments.hypothesis: Have mercy on an unbeliever.

segments.source: Kintu dusra manu khan ke jui pora ulaikene bachai lobi. Isor ke bhoi koribi aru dusra khan uporte daya koribi. Aru mangso laga itcha pora letera kora kapra ke ghin koribi.
segments.reference: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
segments.hypothesis: But save others from greed, fearing God and showing mercy to others, and rejecting the lust of the flesh.

segments.source: Etiya ekjon jun apnikhan ke giribole thaka pora bachai kene rakhe aru Tai laga mohima usorte eku golti aru letera nathaki kene khushi pora khara kori bole diye,
segments.reference: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,
segments.hypothesis: to him who will save you from fall and will present you without blemish and defect in his glory with joy,

segments.source: amikhan laga Isor aru Tran-korta Probhu Jisu Khrista ke, mohima hobole dibi, Tai laga mohanta, aru sob uporte raj kori bole dibi, aru takot, sob homoi te, etiya aru hodai tak thaki bole dibo. Amen.
segments.reference: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
segments.hypothesis: to the God of our salvation and to the Lord Jesus Christ be the glory, the glory, the power, and the dominion over all things, forever and ever. Amen.
